rules: LOD may aggregate maneuvers but cannot reroll force identity, destroyed units, occupation or signed agreements.
Major battles/operations, capital losses, occupation, mass casualties, ceasefires, armistices and peace remain explicit records.
Player absence does not make wars safer, deadlier or more likely.
Player presence may increase tactical detail only; it must not change strategic inputs merely for drama.
Save/load with the same state/event stream produces the same strategic result.
